whoItsFor: Illustrators and designers who want an open-source, Illustrator-style vector editor that runs on desktop or in the browser. It also suits developers and AI agents that need to draw and export vector art through the MCP server.
useCases: Drawing and editing vector illustrations and posters with Pen, Pathfinder and Gradient tools
Opening, editing and exporting SVG, PDF and PNG files
Letting AI agents create and export artwork through the MCP server

requirements.os: macOS, Windows, Linux or FreeBSD (also runs in the browser via WebAssembly)
